Base URL: https://api.company.com/v1

Authentication:

Authentication:
---------------
- All requests require an API key in the header:
  Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>
- API keys are generated in the dashboard under "Settings → API Keys".
- Tokens expire after 30 days. Refresh by generating a new key.

Rate Limits:
------------
- Maximum 60 requests per minute per API key.
- Exceeding the limit returns 429 Too Many Requests.

- Exceeding the limit returns 429 Too Many Requests.

Error Codes:
------------
- 400 Bad Request — invalid input
- 401 Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key
- 403 Forbidden — action not allowed

- 401 Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key
- 403 Forbidden — action not allowed
- 404 Not Found — resource does not exist
- 429 Too Many Requests — rate limit exceeded
- 500 Internal Server Error — temporary server issue

Best Practices:

Best Practices:
---------------
1. Always validate API responses before using.
2. Use HTTPS for all requests.
3. Implement retry logic for 5xx errors.
4. Cache GET requests if possible to reduce load.

# Installation Guide — Company AI Support System

# Installation Guide — Company AI Support System

Overview
This guide explains how to install, configure, and run the Company AI Support System.
The application is built with Java 17, Maven, and a connection to Gemini API for AI responses.
It supports both console and REST modes.

It supports both console and REST modes.

System Requirements

* Java 17 or later (OpenJDK or Oracle JDK)
* Maven 3.8.0+
* Internet connection (for Gemini API access)

* Maven 3.8.0+
* Internet connection (for Gemini API access)
* 2 GB of free RAM minimum
* Operating System: Windows 10+, macOS 12+, or Linux (Ubuntu 20.04+)

Checking Java and Maven Installation

Checking Java and Maven Installation

1. Open a terminal or command prompt.
2. Verify Java:
   java -version
   Expected output example:
   openjdk version "17.0.11"

Expected output example:
   openjdk version "17.0.11"
3. Verify Maven:
   mvn -v
   If Maven is missing, install it:

   * On macOS: brew install maven

* On macOS: brew install maven
   * On Ubuntu: sudo apt install maven
   * On Windows: download from [https://maven.apache.org/download.cgi](https://maven.apache.org/download.cgi)

Project Setup

Project Setup

1. Clone the repository:
   git clone [https://gitlab.com/company/ai-support-system.git](https://gitlab.com/company/ai-support-system.git)
2. Navigate into the project folder:
   cd ai-support-system
3. Install dependencies:

cd ai-support-system
3. Install dependencies:
   mvn clean install

Before running the application, set the Gemini API key.
